newsitem.title: ITALY: POLL-Italy mkt short-term rate expectations stable.
newsitem.headline: POLL-Italy mkt short-term rate expectations stable.

text.p: Italian market interest rate expectations appear to have stabilised with operators still not seeing any significant fall in the overnight rate for a year, a study based on implicit rates by Bocconi Univeristy's research arm Igier showed.

The market sees the implicit overnight rate on a one-month horizon at 6.89 percent compared with 6.94 percent seen a week ago and an actual market close of 7.02 percent on Thursday, the day on which the study was based.
On a three-month horizon the market continued to see the implicit o/n rate at 6.67 percent, the same level as last week. This compares with 6.62 percent seen a month ago.
On a one-year horizon, the implicit o/n rate was seen slightly higher at 6.05 percent from 5.93 percent a week ago but still below the 6.23 percent seen one month ago.
On a two-year timeframe, the implicit o/n rate was seen at 5.86 percent from 5.72 percent seen a week ago and 6.28 percent seen one month ago.

The spread between Italian and German implicit overnight rates, considered a good indicator of market confidence of Italy's entry in European monetary union, stood at 135 basis points compared with 132 bps one week ago. One month ago the spread stood at 172 bps.
